const wechat_protocol::media::MAX_VIDEO_DOWNLOAD_BYTES | usize | Incoming video plaintext limit, matching the ordinary-file download and automatic-download ceiling. Every such transfer stays bound to the advertised length and MD5. Outgoing preparation keeps the separate `wechat_media::MAX_VIDEO_SOURCE_BYTES` source limit.
const wechat_protocol::media::STICKER_HOSTS | &[&str] | Sticker bytes come from Tencent CDN hosts. Classic stored and pack emoji carry a `wxapp.tc.qq.com` source, while shared stickers use `snsvideo.c2c.wechat.com`; both are reachable directly, unlike the encrypted attachment channels. Any other host stays refused so a crafted message cannot turn this into an arbitrary fetch.
const wechat_protocol::media_send::VOICE_UPLOAD_CHUNK_BYTES | usize | Encoded SILK bytes carried by one `uploadvoice` request. A short-link request travels in one MMTLS record of at most 65,519 plaintext bytes, including the route, packet header and envelope, so a 60-second note (about 126-131 KB from the bundled 16 kbit/s profile) cannot use one request. 32 KiB matches the `downloadvoice` range size and leaves room for that overhead.

const wechat_protocol::silk::BIT_RATE | u32 | Target bit rate of the single bundled encoder profile (`silk_bridge.c`). SILK's wideband range tops out here; the previous 16 kbit/s profile was audibly destructive for anything richer than speech, and the rate control is soft, so the actual stream lands well under this ceiling.
const wechat_protocol::silk::FRAME_MS | u32 | Duration of one encoded SILK packet in the bundled profile.
const wechat_protocol::silk::MAX_NOTE_BYTES | usize | Encoded-size bound for one maximum-length note from the bundled profile: the 10-byte header plus, per 20 ms packet, a 2-byte length prefix and the 40 kbit/s payload budget (100 bytes) with 1.5x headroom. SILK rate control is soft, so single packets may exceed the budget; the observed 60-second worst case (full-scale white noise) averages about 2.2 KB/s, or 131 KB.
const wechat_protocol::silk::MAX_NOTE_MS | u32 | Longest single voice note: the official 60-second voice-message limit.
const wechat_protocol::silk::MAX_SAMPLES | usize | MISSING DOC
const wechat_protocol::silk::MAX_STREAM_BYTES | usize | Largest stream accepted by framing validation and decoding.
const wechat_protocol::silk::SAMPLE_RATE | u32 | MISSING DOC

enum wechat_protocol::calls::audio_packet::TransmitScope | enum | The owner must establish a fresh media generation before authorizing sends. The legacy relay scope trades cross-direction audio nonce uniqueness for interoperability with peers that share media key material. It also permits authenticated receive nonce reuse, with bounded ciphertext replay filtering.

mod wechat_protocol | - | Connect to WeChat, authenticate, synchronize and submit messages with [`NativeClient`].
mod wechat_protocol::business | - | Business encryption is separate from authenticated MMTLS records.
mod wechat_protocol::calls | - | Call signaling codecs, authenticated host routes and media packet transforms.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::app_frame | - | Selected call-app task framing. Only the explicitly negotiated crypto0 app session is supported. Host transport authentication and media AEAD are separate. These functions prepare/parse bytes; they do not send or retry an operation.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::app_session | - | Generic call-app authentication messages and the negotiated unencrypted app session. Host MMTLS authentication remains required. No socket or credential persistence is performed here; app encryption is distinct from media AEAD.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::audio_packet | - | Selected Live96 envelope and ordinary95 Opus-primary framing. Encoding these bytes does not establish negotiated capabilities, room ownership or permission to send. Media transmission requires a separately admitted generation/scope.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::conference | - | Voice conference creation and additional invitation codecs. These builders perform no I/O, allocate no task/intent IDs and never retry.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::host_policy | - | Inspect the active authentication response before selecting a call host RPC. A selected Ax route must not silently fall back to ordinary host packing. This module selects no keys, prepares no request and performs no transport.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::host_transport | - | Call-specific ordinary reply policy and non-sensitive transport diagnostics. A verified host transport may return either owned ordinary key mode. This does not change request selection or authorize Ax/app/media key substitution.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::incoming | - | Offline incoming call carriers and conference notification envelopes.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::personal | - | Personal-call request codecs. Preparation performs no transport or account I/O.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::relay | - | Selected IPv4 personal relay setup: one initial check-in, at most one learned continuation and explicit Ready. CRC/TEA structural checks are not media AEAD. The host owns sockets, current account/key generations, time and randomness.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::signaling | - | Experimental offline call-signaling codecs.
mod wechat_protocol::calls::voice_offer | - | Local voice advertisements are distinct from returned selected capabilities. A fresh offer advertises only the supported Opus17 bit. The server's selected codec number, packet format and channel flags require separate admission.
mod wechat_protocol::contact_sync | - | Linux 4.1.13.26 contact stream (CGI8674). This stream has its own `rs_config`/`sync_11` cursor; the message SyncKey is only request context.
mod wechat_protocol::crypto | - | MISSING DOC
mod wechat_protocol::file_upload | - | File-upload message reservation. This authenticated request can affect the account's message state; callers must persist its receipt and never retry an uncertain response automatically.
mod wechat_protocol::media | - | Bounded native CDN transport. This uses the observed HTTP carrier on port 443, not HTTPS. Media encryption and advertised size/digests are checked separately.
mod wechat_protocol::media_send | - | Final media-message metadata. CDN upload and message submission are separate steps; persist source bytes, generated keys and intent before either step.
mod wechat_protocol::mmtls | - | Fresh pinned MMTLS handshake and authenticated shortlink exchange.
mod wechat_protocol::openim | - | Read one exact OpenIM contact through the supported native contact operation.
mod wechat_protocol::protobuf | - | Bounded numbered protobuf primitives. Unknown fields and full u64 values survive.
mod wechat_protocol::push | - | Persistent authenticated incoming notifications. The outer longlink command is distinct from the encrypted business CGI: heartbeat 238/518, sync 121/138.
mod wechat_protocol::quote_send | - | Quoted app-message metadata. Callers resolve the selected message and persist this reference and the final XML before submitting a send attempt.
mod wechat_protocol::silk | - | Bounded independent SILK SDK wrapper. Public source/license pins are under vendor/silk; no WeChat codec library is linked or loaded.
mod wechat_protocol::wire | - | Typed numbered business messages for the supported native profile.
struct wechat_protocol::AccountIdentity | struct { public fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_protocol::AccountLease | struct { private fields } | Cheap authority check for account workers. It carries no credentials and becomes invalid on shutdown or any accepted credential renewal. It cannot replace the final submission guard on an authenticated signaling request.
struct wechat_protocol::AccountPersistenceFailed | struct unit | A verified response could not commit its account update. The response may still be retained independently; this error never authorizes resubmission.
struct wechat_protocol::AccountPushConnection | struct { private fields } | Persistent account connection for callers that already own blocking workers. Requests and notification waits use the same account admission and handoff barriers as ordinary operations. Reconnect after a credential generation changes; an old authenticated socket cannot adopt newer credentials.
struct wechat_protocol::AccountRequest | struct<'a> { private fields } | A single logical operation borrowing this client's temporary request state. It is not an account owner and cannot outlive request_blocking. No operation accepts an independently mutable AccountState. Use ordinary async client methods unless the embedding application already owns a blocking worker.
struct wechat_protocol::AccountState | struct { public fields } | Accepted credentials. Serialize only into the service's encrypted state vault.
struct wechat_protocol::AccountStatus | struct { public fields } | Non-secret account lifecycle information. Credentials require an explicit export; status/debug output must never contain an AccountState.
struct wechat_protocol::AddMessage | struct { public fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_protocol::AuthSnapshot | struct { public fields } | Raw accepted auth sections, retained only inside the encrypted account state. The update mask describes native application gates; presence alone does not mean an optional section changed active account credentials.

struct wechat_protocol::NativeRequestNotSubmitted | struct unit | The operation stopped before business bytes were handed to transport. This marker is never attached to a timeout, rejected reply or post-handoff fence.

struct wechat_protocol::PendingLogout | struct { private fields } | One reserved terminal operation. Reservation stops account admission without sending anything. An embedding daemon can commit local logout inhibition before consuming this token to submit its optional remote logout. Dropping the token leaves the account stopped and sends no request.

struct wechat_protocol::calls::app_frame::AppFrameParameters | struct<'a> { public fields } | Selected SDK/device and host configuration. The app's cloud-device string is distinct from its fresh 32-byte auth device and the host account device ID.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::app_frame::TaskFrame | struct { public fields } | A decoded app task header. Values may contain private identities, so no Debug.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::app_session::AppAuthority | struct { public fields } | Accepted account/logout binding chosen by the account owner, not values recovered from an unauthenticated server message. It is not a session key.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::app_session::AppSession | struct { private fields } | Server-selected app identity. No app keys exist in this branch. The server does not install the encrypted branch's default expiry. Host account/logout authority still fences every use; hosts may impose a separate local deadline. Private app identities intentionally do not implement Debug or Serialize.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::app_session::PendingAppAuth | struct { private fields } | One first-auth request. Consuming completion prevents accidental reuse after success, malformed data or rejection. The host must retain uncertain intent outcomes separately instead of automatically preparing another attempt.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::audio_packet::AggregateAudio | struct<'a> { public fields } | Member metadata accompanying one nested audio payload. The member list does not establish independent PCM tracks or prove that every listed member spoke.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::audio_packet::Live96 | struct { private fields } | One key/base/generation owner. No Clone, reset or implicit rekey is provided. The 64-sequence RX window is a local policy; rollover requires a verified new generation. Socket-source validation must happen before `open`.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::audio_packet::MediaContext | struct { public fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_protocol::calls::audio_packet::MediaEpoch | struct { public fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_protocol::calls::audio_packet::OpenedPayload | struct { private fields } | Authenticated current-generation payload. Clear headers are not fully in AAD; protected member equality and external source/room/roster checks remain needed. Contents have no Debug/Serialize implementation.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::audio_packet::OrdinaryAudio | struct<'a> { public fields } | Encoded Opus primaries, not decoded audio. The caller must establish that the current negotiation selects this codec/layout before decoding.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::conference::AddMembersResponse | struct { public fields } | Adding contacts cannot allocate or replace the current room. Optional reply identity fields are retained and checked when present; omitted fields are not silently replaced with zero-valued identities.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::conference::CreateResponse | struct { public fields } | Raw authenticated creation result. Allocation, invitation outcomes and the nested client response remain separate. This type never invents participants from invitees and deliberately does not implement Debug or serialization.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::conference::InvitationResult | struct { public fields } | One server invitation outcome. On a successful outer response, code zero means submission, not acceptance by a participant. Missing and present-zero codes retain distinct presence.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::host_transport::CallHostRpcError | struct { public fields } | Only fixed labels and optional numeric protocol/status codes are retained. Underlying error text, hosts, response bytes and keys are never included.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::host_transport::CallLiveSyncInterrupted | struct unit | A pre-answer LiveSync was superseded locally. The transport may have sent it, but its reply must never update the room cursor or account state.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::incoming::CancelNotification | struct { public fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_protocol::calls::incoming::ConferenceJoinContext | struct { public fields } | Room-entry context carried by a group invitation. It is pending call data, not a joined roster or account authority. The embedding actor binds it to the authenticated message envelope and a current account generation.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::incoming::ConferenceNotification | struct { public fields } | Conference envelope. Unsupported kinds remain readable as raw numbers and bytes; [`Self::payload`] refuses to invent a supported control for them.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::incoming::InviteNotification | struct { public fields } | Presence and full integer widths are preserved. This is not an admitted invitation: missing identities, unknown enums and peer/account bindings require independent validation before a controller can ring.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::incoming::NotificationCarrier | struct { private fields } | Opaque outer fields survive without assigning semantics to unnamed slots. These fields and the forwarded bytes can contain private call information; none of the data-bearing notification types implement `Debug`.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::personal::HostRequest | struct { private fields } | Encoded inner host operation. It does not imply authorization to dispatch. Bodies may contain private identities and are deliberately not Debug.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::personal::InviteResponse | struct { public fields } | Raw caller response, distinct from the callee Join response. Decode after host CommonResponse authentication and success; it does not install a room. Secret room values and original fields deliberately have no Debug output.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::personal::JoinClientResponse | struct { public fields } | Caller client context retains original Strategy separately from later current capability/AV snapshots. Retry seconds are not IM mode or a sync deadline.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::personal::LiveSyncItem | struct { public fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_protocol::calls::personal::LiveSyncResponse | struct { public fields } | A complete caller-sync reply. A decoder preserves unfamiliar items; the account owner must handle all supported effects before committing `cookies`. An unknown item is not evidence that advancing the cursor is safe.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::personal::VoiceInputs | struct<'a> { public fields } | Caller-supplied, selected direct-voice request settings. Nested protobufs are checked for their known wire types while unknown fields remain byte-identical.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::personal::VoiceRoom | struct { public fields } | Owned room correlation supplied only after the matching Join/Invite reply. Member zero is valid. Room/key are private and deliberately not Debug.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::relay::RelayEpoch | struct { public fields } | MISSING DOC
struct wechat_protocol::calls::relay::RoomInputs | struct { public fields } | Selected initial/reset room values. Constructors are deliberately scoped to this personal profile; they do not describe every supported server transport.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::relay::SelectedRelay | struct { public fields } | An endpoint selected from an admitted Strategy. No DNS or fallback is used. Room key and media material intentionally have no Debug representation.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::relay::TwoRttRelay | struct { private fields } | No retries or network I/O. Every preparation is spent before randomness or encryption; failure closes this attempt instead of making it reusable.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::signaling::CloudRequest | struct { public fields } | Conference-to-host callback envelope. Bodies can contain private data, so this and the network envelopes intentionally do not implement `Debug`.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::signaling::CommonRequest | struct { public fields } | Standard base request plus an opaque inner operation body. The existing [`crate::wire::base_request`] prepares the standard base message. Validation checks wire kinds and widths, not credential or account suitability.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::signaling::CommonResponse | struct { public fields } | Standard base response plus an opaque inner response. Decoding does not establish success: inspect the return code before admitting an inner reply.
struct wechat_protocol::calls::voice_offer::VoiceOffer | struct { private fields } | Owned request metadata for one call generation. It intentionally has no `Clone` or `Debug`: create a fresh identity for each new call. The embedding owner must supply new random bytes and keep this value until that call ends.

struct wechat_protocol::media::VideoRepresentationMismatch | struct { public fields } | A complete video transfer at or below the ordinary transfer threshold decrypted successfully but did not match the selected message tuple. The download is still rejected. Only fixed numeric controls and comparison results are kept, so a caller can store a diagnostic without reply bytes or digests. Fields use wire key names; their meanings are not established.

struct wechat_protocol::media_send::VoiceUpload | struct<'a> { private fields } | One voice note submitted through `uploadvoice`. A note of at most [`VOICE_UPLOAD_CHUNK_BYTES`] uses a single request with the end flag set. A larger note is sent as consecutive byte ranges (offset/length) under the same client message ID; only the last range sets the end flag, and later ranges carry a server message ID returned for an earlier range. Each range is submitted once: an error after any submission is an uncertain outcome.

trait wechat_protocol::AccountPersistence | trait: core::marker::Send + core::marker::Sync | Persist an accepted account update before it becomes visible to other client operations. Implementations store data only: they must not call back into the client, perform network operations, or implement authentication/retry policy. A failed write leaves in-memory state unchanged and never retries a request.
